stem: For \(x > 0\), which of the following is equivalent to \(\sqrt{72x^{4}}\)?

explanation.B: Incorrect. This is the result of taking \(\sqrt{x^{4}}\) as \(x\); the square root halves the exponent, giving \(x^{2}\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the result of dropping the factor \(\sqrt{2}\) after writing \(72 = 36 \cdot 2\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the result of writing 72 as \(36 \cdot 3\); in fact \(36 \cdot 2 = 72\).

verify:
X0 = Symbol('x'); x = symbols('x', positive=True)
v = lambda k: value(choices[k]).subs([(X0, x)])
t = sqrt(72*x**4)
assert simplify(v(answer) - t) == 0
assert all(simplify(v(k) - t) != 0 for k in choices if k != answer)
